mapper.select: SELECT u.cognito_sub AS cognitoSub, u.email AS email, r.role_name AS role, p.onboarding_status AS onboardingStatus, p.budget AS budget FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON u.cognito_sub = ur.user_sub LEFT JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles p ON u.cognito_sub = p.user_sub WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.email
